name: MEI-Bench
description: MEI-Bench (Minimal Evidence Intervention Benchmark) is a diagnostic benchmark for testing whether vision-language models ground answers in relevant visual evidence. It pairs minimal evidence regions with area-matched sham controls and applies five targeted interventions (evidence blur, sham blur, evidence gray-out, sham gray-out, evidence content swap) to 615 COCO val2017 items.
citation: Sumit, S. S., Tahtali, M., and Mirjalili, S. Controlled Evidence Interventions for Diagnosing Visual Grounding in Vision-Language Models. Proceedings of the 18th Asian Conference on Machine Learning (ACML 2026), PMLR.

distribution.name: mei_bench.jsonl
distribution.description: 615 MEI-Bench items, one JSON object per line.

recordSet.name: items
recordSet.description: MEI-Bench item records loaded from data/annotations/mei_bench.jsonl.

sourceData.name: COCO 2017 (val2017)
sourceData.description: MEI-Bench references images from COCO val2017 by image id and filename. Raw COCO images are NOT redistributed in this package.

annotationProcess: Each item was authored and reviewed by a project author. Questions were drafted to target one of five task types and to be answerable from a minimal evidence region. Ground-truth answers were verified manually.
regionConstructionProcess: Evidence regions were derived from COCO instance/panoptic annotations and tightened by manual review. Sham regions were selected automatically to satisfy: area_fraction in [0.02, 0.50], evidence/sham IoU <= 0.10, and |sham_area - evidence_area| / evidence_area <= 0.20.
interventionGenerationProcess: Five interventions per item: evidence_blur (Gaussian blur on evidence box), sham_blur (Gaussian blur on sham box), evidence_gray (uniform gray fill on evidence box), sham_gray (uniform gray fill on sham box), evidence_swap (evidence box colour-inverted and its 4x4 blocks randomly shuffled). Blur: OpenCV Gaussian kernel 51; gray value 128. See docs/intervention_generation.md.
rawImageRedistributionStatement: Raw COCO images are NOT redistributed by this package. Users download COCO val2017 from the official COCO source.
personalDataStatement: No personal data is newly collected by MEI-Bench. COCO images may contain people; identity attributes are not annotated.
humanSubjectsStatement: No new human-subject data collection is performed by this package.
intendedUse: Diagnostic evaluation of causal visual grounding in vision-language models. Not a safety certification.
limitations: Bounded by COCO val2017 distribution; English-only; fixed intervention parameters per condition; evidence selection reflects authors' judgment of minimality.
rai:dataCollection: References to COCO val2017 images. No new image collection.
rai:dataBiases: Inherits the geographic, demographic, and category distribution biases of COCO.
rai:useCases: Causal visual grounding analysis; sham-control evaluation; VLLM robustness diagnostics.
rai:safetyAndMisuseWarning: Scores must not be interpreted as a safety or deployment readiness certification.

maintenance.updatePolicy: Bug fixes via patch releases. New items or new fields via minor releases. Schema-breaking changes via major releases.
